messages.text:
I turned on reduced motion on my computer, but the cards and the win banner still animate. Could you fix that and keep the rest working? Please follow the project rules.

Read docs/README.md and follow its linked requirements for this project.

Fixed reduced motion for cards and the win banner. Card transitions and the victory pulse now turn off when the system preference is enabled, including when it changes during a game.

The build and all 138 unit tests passed. All three motion browser tests passed, covering normal motion, reduced motion, and preference changes during play.
